name: SPH Fluid
description: Physics Lab — up to 24k particles of weakly compressible SPH liquid (Tait pressure, viscosity, XSPH, vorticity confinement, surface tension) found through the spatial hash, rendered as zero-g droplets of liquid chrome that refract the image. Bright areas are obstacles, the pointer parts the fluid, a click splashes, bass bursts the droplets. graph · 4 passes · @group(1) sim ring + hash.

params.name: Viscosity
params.description: Water-thin to honey-thick: viscosity and XSPH smoothing together

params.name: Rest Density
params.description: Low lets the liquid swell, high pulls it into tighter droplets (capped so a hash cell never overfills)

params.name: Pointer Force
params.description: How hard the pointer parts the fluid (hold for full strength) and how big a click splashes

params.name: Obstacle Strength
params.description: How firmly the image's bright areas push the liquid away and slow it down

simRing.packing: stride 2 — simState[2p] = xy position (px), zw velocity (px/frame); simState[2p+1] = (-1, -1, density, vorticity), an aux record parked at xy < 0 so the hash never sees it. 32768 particles fit; 24576 are active, the rest stay parked.
